sceneConcept: A lean thirty-year-old Chinese covert operative stands alone against a transparent background. His short side-parted black undercut and cool grey eyes give him a controlled, unreadable look. A fitted long charcoal-grey tactical coat hangs open over a black high-collared shirt and compact matte protective vest, with black trousers, a discreet utility belt, fingerless gloves and combat boots. His arms are crossed while his weight is already shifted slightly forward, as if prepared to move before anyone else. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the design restrained. Visual refresh: lean segmented armor with a predictive sensor collar and offset harness.
naturalLanguageDetail: A lean thirty-year-old Chinese former covert agent with short side-parted black undercut hair and cool grey eyes stands with crossed arms in a fitted open charcoal-grey tactical coat and compact matte armor, his weight subtly shifted forward under soft even frontal studio light; lean segmented armor with a predictive sensor collar and offset harness.
